verdict.rationale: Jan's own docs say you can give it a task that it works on autonomously (files, commands, web research). They also describe autonomous agents running on your hardware that take actions via WhatsApp, Discord or Slack, plus browser automation through Jan Browser MCP. However, nothing documents setting up recurring or triggered automations that run unattended in the background. The MCP docs also require approving each tool call individually in the chat, which limits true background autonomy. missing for 10: scheduling/trigger-based automation setup, evidence of unattended background execution without per-call approval, independent or hands-on corroboration.
